verdict.rationale: Railway documents an official CLI that deploys from the terminal, which covers the deploy half of the story. Nothing shows a single command that scaffolds a new project and deploys it. The "one command" evidence covers installing the CLI and agent tooling, and project or template creation is described through MCP-driven AI assistants or one-click dashboard starters, not a CLI command. Missing for 10: a documented single CLI command that scaffolds a new project, a combined scaffold-and-deploy flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: Develop locally and deploy from your terminal with the Railway CLI.
